title: Happy Path : Verify successful login and navigation to procedure workflow

Upload valid .cer certificate file
Upload valid .key private key fil
Enter password: <efirma-key-password>
Click Ingresar
On role selection page, select Persona Moral from dropdown and  click Aceptar
steps.expected: Role selection page should be displayed User should be navigated to home page after selecting role

steps.action: On home page, click on Trámites Click on Solicitudes nuevas

On “Selección de trámite” page, search for Procedure number 260603 
  Click on the hyperlink of the procedure
steps.expected:
Clicking the hyperlink should open the procedure details page

The procedure title should be displayed as “Permiso sanitario de importación de medicamentos destinados a pruebas de laboratorio”

title: Happy Path – Verify optional document upload and navigation to Paso 3

steps.action: Update mandatory fields in Paso 1 and navigate to Paso 2 – Anexar requisitos

Observe optional documents section
Select any random document type from Tipo de documento dropdown
Click on Agregar

Selected document should be added successfully

“Cargar archivos” button should enabled

title: Happy Path – Verify signing, folio generation, and acuse download

Upload valid .cer certificate file (AAL user)
Upload valid .key private key file
Enter password: <efirma-key-password>
Click on Firmar
steps.expected:
User should be navigated to Acuse de Recibo page

"Tu solicitud ha sido registrada con el siguiente número de folio ."

Folio number should be generated successfully

Documento: Acuse de recepción de trámite should be displayed

steps.action: User should be able to click on download icon
steps.expected: File should be downloaded successfully to local system
